name: adversarial-review
description: Run a multi-agent adversarial review of repository changes with explicit read-only and fix modes.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent adversarial review for repository changes
interface.longDescription: Run a multi-agent adversarial review with bundled Claude and Codex orchestration. Reviews are read-only by default; only an explicit apply-fixes request may modify the target repository.
defaultPrompt: Run a multi-agent adversarial review; use review-only unless I explicitly request apply-fixes.
